answer: Each agent synthesizes the verifier-named cipher tone sequence at 44100 Hz for 30 seconds, tones rising like a tide, and publishes the waveform hash within 30 minutes. The verifier resynthesizes the same sequence and compares hashes, while peers check the public log. One honest agent runs 1 job on 4 CPU cores for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must run 10 jobs on 40 cores, so cost rises 10X, a gale of parallel jobs no cheap host sustains. A wrong hash or timeout slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
